newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-OUT-OF-FAVOUR BAGGIO BACK FOR MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-OUT-OF-FAVOUR BAGGIO BACK FOR MILAN.

text.p: Milan coach Oscar Tabarez, heavily criticised after a poor start to the season, is banking on millionaire-substitute Roberto Baggio to help revive the club's fortunes.

With five first-choice players out through injury after another midweek Champions League loss -- 2-1 to Sweden's Gothenburg -- Tabarez said he could no longer afford to omit Baggio in Sunday's home match against Napoli.

"I think Baggio will be more useful to us as a winger on the left side, rather than as a playmaker," Tabarez told reporters on Saturday, quashing rumours he would again leave the star out in favour of a more defensive line-up.

The Uruguayan coach, signed on a one-year contract to replace the hugely-successful Fabio Capello, will have been little comforted by a qualified vote of confidence from Milan managing director Adriano Galliani on Saturday.
"At the moment, there is no possibility Tabarez will be sacked," Galliani said.
Baggio, who has seen little action since September 11, when Milan lost 3-2 at home to Portugal's Porto in a Champions League match, said he was ready.
"I'm ready to go -- like I've always been," he said.
"I've trained well and am not afraid of the responsibility. It will be tough against Napoli, but I'm familiar with tough games, like the (1994) World Cup final against Brazil."
He will line up on the left in midfield where a spot has opened up after the injuries of Montenegrin Dejan Savicevic, Stefano Eranio, Tomas Locatelli and Dutchman Edgar Davids.
